root_cause: The existing OAuth link creation used a fixed account alias, and the provider reserves aliases even while an earlier connection is no longer suitable for publishing.
prevention_rule: On the exact alias-occupied response only, retry one user-initiated OAuth link with a uniquely named pending account; never transfer old authorization, consider an alias proof of identity, or publish without verified connected-account ID and company scopes.

evidence.source: Public linked-account API behavior and source regression only; private connection identifiers and credentials intentionally excluded.

resolution: Not live or proven; protected release and real provider OAuth are mandatory. No public post is implied.
